tools.name: search_designs
tools.description: Search the public Printlooper marketplace of 3D-printable designs by keyword or category. Returns titles, sizes, images and the page where a buyer can order a print or a seller can add the design to their shop.

tools.name: get_design
tools.description: Details of one public design from search_designs: description, size, tags, whether it needs hardware, and its page.

tools.name: list_print_shops
tools.description: Search Printlooper print shops (the makers who print and ship orders) by location, material, lead time and multicolor capability.

tools.name: get_print_shop
tools.description: One print shop with its printers, materials and colors, and recent reviews.

tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: Materials, finishes, strengths and colors the Printlooper print shops offer, with how many shops offer each. Filter colors by material, finish or color family.

tools.name: how_to_order_a_print
tools.description: How a buyer gets their own 3D model printed and shipped: the page to upload it, accepted files, and what happens next. Use this when someone has an STL or 3MF and wants it printed.

tools.name: stage_model_from_url
tools.description: Download an STL or 3MF model from a public https link (a direct download, not a web page) and stage it on Printlooper, where its geometry is checked. Works signed in (to list it) or not (to order a print). Files up to 50 MB. Then call get_staged_file until status is ready.

tools.name: start_model_upload
tools.description: For agents that can read local files (Claude Code, Cursor): returns a signed URL to PUT an STL or 3MF to, with the exact headers to send. After the upload, call complete_model_upload. Chat apps should use stage_model_from_url instead. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: complete_model_upload
tools.description: Tell Printlooper the file from start_model_upload has been uploaded, so it starts checking it. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: get_staged_file
tools.description: Status of a model from stage_model_from_url or start_model_upload: processing, ready (with size in mm, grams and parts) or failed (with the reason).

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Who is connected: first name, account type (designer, seller or print shop), which permissions were granted, and where to manage the account. Call this first to know which tools apply. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: A seller's products or a designer's designs, newest first, with status and price. For a product, storefront_published says whether it is shown on the storefront, which is what pause_listing and resume_listing change. Page with starting_after set to next_cursor. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.description: Orders that earned this account money (sales, royalties, design work), newest first, with order status and earnings. No buyer details. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: get_my_earnings
tools.description: Paid, pending and reversed earnings in US dollars (cents), and when the last payout was made. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: get_my_store
tools.description: A seller's Printlooper storefront: its link, how many products are live, and whether Shopify is connected. product_feed_url is a public, read only list of the live products for a site the seller runs themselves: show them there and link each Buy button to the product url, where the buyer pays on Pri

tools.name: get_listing_options
tools.description: For a marketplace design (from search_designs) or a staged model, quotes what print shops charge to make it, the platform fee and royalty, and the retail price that leaves a chosen margin. Use it before suggesting a price. Returns the page to create the listing. Each quote lists the materials and co

tools.name: create_listing_draft
tools.description: Starts a listing from a ready staged model with the title, description, tags and price you suggest. Pass the shop, material and colors from get_listing_options when the user chose them, and the listing page starts on them. The user opens complete_url to confirm they own the rights, pick the shop and

tools.name: update_listing
tools.description: Change an existing listing's title, description or tags, or a seller product's price and compare-at price. Description is plain text (blank lines start new paragraphs). Only listings from list_my_listings. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: pause_listing
tools.description: Hide a seller product from your Printlooper storefront. Nothing is deleted; resume_listing shows it again. Shopify listings are not changed. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: resume_listing
tools.description: Show a seller product you hid with pause_listing on your Printlooper storefront again. It cannot put a listing on the storefront for the first time; that happens on Printlooper. Showing it again publishes it again, so it takes the designer royalty as it is now (returned as royalty_percent). Needs a

tools.name: add_listing_photos
tools.description: Adds photos to one of your seller products, from public https links to PNG or JPG images (up to 10 MB each) or from images the user attached, where the app passes attached files to tools. New photos go after the ones already on the listing; none is removed or reordered. A listing holds 6 photos. Onl

tools.name: get_marketing_kit
tools.description: Everything needed to write social posts, ads or an email about one of your listings: title, description, price, image links, the page link with tracking for the channel, and audience notes. Also returns a guide for the chosen channel (image shapes and sizes, how a post is usually built, where the li

tools.name: list_available_hardware
tools.description: Parts (magnets, inserts, bearings and more) that Printlooper print shops stock and have confirmed exact dimensions for, ready to build a design around on Printlooper. Filter by words in the part name.

tools.name: preview_hardware_pocket
tools.description: The exact openings Printlooper would cut for a confirmed part at given fit settings, before a design is made around it.

tools.name: get_my_shop
tools.description: Your print shop: name, approval, capacity, daily order cap, lead time, every material with its prices and colors, and how many products of its own it sells (list them with list_my_products). Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: update_shop_profile
tools.description: Change your shop's public description or its default lead time in days. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: set_shop_capacity
tools.description: Pause new orders (your pending orders are rerouted to other shops and your sellers are told), resume them, or change your daily order cap. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: set_material_prices
tools.description: Change the prices of one of your materials (price per gram, minimum job, failure surcharge, setup and post-processing fees, lead time). New quotes use them right away. Show the user the change before making it. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: add_material
tools.description: Add a material your shop prints (PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, ASA, RESIN or NYLON) with its prices. Then add colors with add_material_colors. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: add_material_colors
tools.description: Add the colors (filaments) you stock for one of your materials, each with a name, a hex color and a finish. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: get_pricing_benchmarks
tools.description: How your price per gram and minimum job compare with other approved Printlooper shops, per material (low quartile, median, high quartile). Shown only where enough shops offer the material to keep each shop anonymous. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: estimate_job_price
tools.description: What your shop would charge for a print of a given weight in one of your materials, with the breakdown, for one unit or a batch. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: list_my_products
tools.description: The products your print shop sells: the ones sellers list from your catalog and the ones on your own shop page. Newest first, with wholesale price, variants, where each one is published, how many seller listings use it and their sales. Page with starting_after set to next_cursor. Needs a connected P

tools.name: get_my_product
tools.description: One product from list_my_products in full: its description, tags, prices, the text printed on its insert card, where it is published, and each variant with its price and photos. Use it before suggesting better photos or a better description. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: add_product_photos
tools.description: Adds photos to one variant of one of your print shop's products, from public https links to PNG or JPG images (up to 10 MB each) or from images the user attached, where the app passes attached files to tools. Each photo is copied into Printlooper. New photos go after the ones already on the variant;

tools.name: update_my_product
tools.description: Change the title, description, tags or insert card text (material line, care instructions, warnings) of one of your print shop's products. The change shows at once wherever the product is published, and the answer gives what each changed field was before. Prices and where the product is published ar

tools.name: preview_catalog_import
tools.description: Checks rows from your spreadsheet before importing them as your own products (sold to Printlooper sellers): which rows have problems, how many products and variants it makes, and whether your plan has room. Changes nothing. Rows from the shop spreadsheet, one per product or variant. Each needs title

tools.name: import_catalog
tools.description: Imports rows from your spreadsheet as your own products, published to Printlooper sellers. Run preview_catalog_import first and get the user to agree. All rows must be valid; nothing is imported if any row has a problem. Rows from the shop spreadsheet, one per product or variant. Each needs title, w

tools.name: list_open_jobs
tools.description: Print jobs assigned to your shop that are not shipped yet, oldest first, with status, quantity and deadline. No buyer details. Accept and ship jobs on Printlooper. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: list_my_hardware
tools.description: Hardware your shop stocks (magnets, inserts, screws and more), with stock, price, whether you confirmed its exact dimensions, and whether designers are offered it (with the reason when they are not). Needs a connected Printlooper account.

tools.name: draft_hardware_from_datasheet
tools.description: Reads a part's datasheet (a public https link, or pasted text) and drafts its catalog entry and exact dimensions. Every number is checked against a quoted line of the source, and nothing is saved. Review it with the user, then confirm with confirm_hardware_dimensions. Needs a connected Printlooper a

tools.name: confirm_hardware_dimensions
tools.description: Records your shop’s confirmation of the exact part and dimensions you stock, so designers can build parts around it. Only confirm a part you have checked: designs are cut to these numbers. Give evidence: a datasheet link or how you measured it. Needs a connected Printlooper account.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_print_shop, stage_model_from_url, start_model_upload, get_my_store, get_marketing_kit · Private data: how_to_order_a_print, stage_model_from_url, start_model_upload, complete_model_upload, get_staged_file, add_listing_photos, add_product_photos, confirm_hardware_dimensions · Public sink: how_to_order_a_print, start_model_upload, complete_model_upload, create_listing_draft, get_marketing_kit, set_material_prices · Destructive: import_catalog.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_print_shop, stage_model_from_url, start_model_upload, get_my_store, get_marketing_kit · Private data: how_to_order_a_print, stage_model_from_url, start_model_upload, complete_model_upload, get_staged_file, add_listing_photos, add_product_photos, confirm_hardware_dimensions · Public sink: how_to_order_a_print, start_model_upload, complete_model_upload, create_listing_draft, get_marketing_kit, set_material_prices · Destructive: import_catalog

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
